notes.text: I could not work out which plan included the reports feature.
Setup took ten minutes and was painless.
The pricing page was clear to me, I picked the team plan in a minute.
I had to email sales to understand what the per-seat price included.
I never looked at pricing, my manager bought it.
The onboarding emails were too frequent.
Billing is monthly and that is what I expected.
I use the free plan and have no reason to upgrade.
